request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Ai2 releases all code, checkpoints, and training details (logs coming soon). Repositories: Open-Instruct (DPO and RLVR) https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct; OLMo-Core (pre-training and SFT) https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core; OLMo-Eval (evaluation) https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-Eval. Post-training checkpoints are accessible via HuggingFace revisions (naming step_XXXX) and intermediate SFT/DPO models are linked. Training datasets are linked on HuggingFace: Dolci-Instruct-SFT-7B, Dolci-Instruct-DPO-7B, Dolci-Instruct-RL-7B (plus Think variants).
quotes: We are releasing all code, checkpoints, logs (coming soon), and associated training details.
- Open-Instruct for DPO and RLVR: https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct
- OLMo-Core for pre-training and SFT: https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core
We have released checkpoints for these models. For post-training, the naming convention is `step_XXXX`.
